name: Password Requirements
description: A password field with a reveal control and live policy checks for Unicode text, with clear requirement states and keyboard access for account settings.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled password, never persisted by the component. Without onChange, editing is read-only.

props.name: rules
props.description: Pure named predicates. Defaults count Unicode code points and recognize Unicode letters, numbers, punctuation and symbols. Custom rules run unchanged; empty arrays show no configured requirements.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and reveal control.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Receives each edit for host validation.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

controls.label: Guidance
controls.default: Use a unique phrase you have not used elsewhere.
